commits.comment: 扩展 DynamicCVPipeline 的 MergeCubeBlock 判定策略：原先只允许具有公共输入/输出且同深度的 cube 块合并，现在新增 feedsMatmul 分析，允许通过 SSA 追溯到 producer matmul 的 chained matmul 合并（consumer 的 matmul 输入可追溯到 producer block 中的 matmul，且 producer matmul 无 vector user）。同时修复 BlockDependencyGraph::rebuildAfterMerge 在重新连边时未判断 pred/succ 是否为 target 导致的自环污染问题，改为条件插入并同步更新 predecessors/successors。实现上通过 DenseSet 防重复遍历、使用 blockId 判定操作归属，并在 producer matmul 有 vector user 时拒绝合并，避免破坏向量块依赖。风险在于 feedsMatmul 只沿 SSA 定义回溯且限定同 block，若 producer matmul 被链式运算包裹可能识别不到；合并后 blockId 统一为 target 需要验证下游 dynamic pipeline 生成的正确性，新增 MLIR diff 用例已覆盖主要分支。

test_impact.reason: 新增 chained matmul 合并规则与 BlockDependencyGraph 自环修复都需要回归看护，commit 已新增 6 个 MLIR FileCheck 用例，覆盖可合并、vector 中间值、cycle、vector user 与 same-depth 共享输入等分支。

commits.comment: 修复 block batching 的三个缓存发布点在内容未变化时仍重写文件的问题：FileCacheManager.put() 用 os.replace 换入临时文件导致 inode/mtime 变化，严格 AOT 缓存清单比较 (size, mtime_ns) 会误判为脏并触发重编译。改动：(1) BatchKernel.publish_manifest 在写 block_batching.bundle.json 前先 get_file 判断是否已存在，因为 identity 即 manifest 的 sha256；(2) _freeze_source 的 fingerprint 摘要了 snapshot 本身，已存在则复用 get_file 返回路径；(3) _remember_decline 通过 _cached_decline 读取已有记录，仅当记录缺失或不同才写；同时测试用假 Cache 增加 get_file。实现上 publish_manifest 使用 CacheManager 契约的 get_file 而非 FileCacheManager.has_file，以兼容 CUSTOM_CACHE_NOT_SUPPORTED 拒绝路径仍走自定义 manager 的情况。风险较小，但需注意 get_file 在自定义 CacheManager 实现中必须返回 None/路径语义一致；cache 命中路径现在多一次读取，性能影响可忽略。

test_impact.reason: 幂等写入的行为通过 mtime/inode 是否变化来断言，需要新增测试；commit 已添加 test_frozen_snapshot_is_written_once_per_fingerprint、test_republished_manifest_keeps_the_stored_entry_byte_identical、test_rememembering_a_known_decline_leaves_the_record_untouched，并更新 block_batching_test_utils 的假 Cache。

commits.message:
[ascend](fix) do not rewrite unchanged block batching cache entries (#3425)

Three block batching publishers rewrote cache entries that had not
changed. FileCacheManager.put() swaps a freshly written temp file into
place with os.replace() without comparing content, so each publication
minted a new inode and mtime for an identical file. Strict AOT cache
inventories compare (size, mtime_ns), read those entries as modified
artifacts, report the cache as dirty, and force a recompile even though
no kernel or cache content changed.

BatchKernel.publish_manifest() stores block_batching.bundle.json under a
digest of the manifest, and runs on cache hits rather than only after a
compile, so every cached-kernel initialization restamped the sidecar.
_freeze_source() stores block_batching.original.ttir under a fingerprint
that digests the snapshot itself, and restamped it on every freeze.
Replaying a pointwise kernel in a second process reproduced the latter.
Both keys digest the bytes being written, so an entry already present is
byte-identical; skip the write when the key already holds one.

_remember_decline() is reached from _compile_selected() on the cached
selection path, so replaying a selection re-reported identical declines.
Its key does not digest the payload, so this one compares the stored
record through the existing _cached_decline() reader and writes only when
the record is absent or genuinely different.

This matches the _get_or_build_npu_artifact() convention already used for
NPU artifacts. publish_manifest() uses get_file() from the CacheManager
contract rather than FileCacheManager.has_file(), because compile_bundle()
routes a CUSTOM_CACHE_NOT_SUPPORTED refusal into rejected_bundle(), which
still publishes through the configured manager. _freeze_source() has
already proven its manager is a FileCacheManager.

commits.comment: 在 python/triton/runtime/libentry.py 顶部显式 import torch_npu，以兼容 torch >= 2.8 在 TORCH_DEVICE_BACKEND_AUTOLOAD=0 时不会自动加载 out-of-tree 设备后端、导致 torch.npu 未注册从而 import libentry 报 AttributeError 的问题。与 3.2.2.post1 版本行为对齐。注意该文件位于上游 triton 路径，triton-ascend 通过 patch 维护上游差异；此修改若未同步进 triton-ascend-3.6.0.patch，rebuild 时可能被 checkout 还原。缺少 try/except 或延迟导入，在无 torch_npu 的纯 CUDA/AMD 环境导入 libentry 会失败，但本仓库以 Ascend 为主，风险可接受。

test_impact.reason: 该修复针对 TORCH_DEVICE_BACKEND_AUTOLOAD=0 下导入 libentry 的失败场景，现有测试未覆盖该环境变量组合，建议补充一个在禁用自动加载时 import triton.runtime.libentry 的轻量用例；同时需确认该改动已被纳入 patch 文件，避免构建期被还原。

commits.message:
[runtime](fix) import torch_npu explicitly in libentry (#3378)

torch >= 2.8 skips loading out-of-tree device backends when
TORCH_DEVICE_BACKEND_AUTOLOAD=0, so torch.npu is never registered and
importing triton.runtime.libentry fails with
"AttributeError: module 'torch' has no attribute 'npu'".
Import torch_npu explicitly before accessing torch.npu, matching the
behavior of the 3.2.2.post1 release.
